finding.summary: An internally faulted/StopTimeout HTTP domain can receive a fresh C stop interval, and beginning application shutdown grants another fresh shutdown interval.
finding.consequence: No forever-Faulted UI path was found for a nonquiescent owner after its Faulted status is polled: C eventually installs a deadline. However the earliest B stop origin is not shared back to C; an already expired B budget can receive another 5 seconds, then begin_shutdown can delay process exit by another 5 seconds.
fixRecommendation: Expose original B stop deadline as read-only metadata and clamp C deadline to the minimum original value.
For B StopTimeout do not start another stop grace period. Mark terminate_required and clamp app shutdown_deadline to the original expired stop deadline after begin_shutdown.
Keep all exact owners retained during controlled process exit; never detach or replace.

checkedContracts.contract: UI explicit stop uses the same captured origin as B
OS thread return before nonblocking join
checkedContracts.detail: RuntimeOwner.poll calls physical_thread::is_finished before taking and joining the original JoinHandle. On Windows this helper requires both Rust completion and WaitForSingleObject(original HANDLE,0)==WAIT_OBJECT_0. quiescent additionally requires shared returned and join success. Native/SSPI Drop is before setting returned. Native cleanup P1 is under separate repair and is not passed by this review.

checkedContracts.contract: Faulted claims cannot start replacement generation
checkedContracts.detail: Cleanup/Native/Faulted/StopTimeout set retain_claim. A quiescent faulted owner does not call physical_returned, and reservation Drop leaves runtime_owned set after started. reserve_runtime and configuration edit reject the retained claim. C also admits start only from Disabled and quiescent.

checkedContracts.contract: Configuration claim and physical positive activation
checkedContracts.detail: reserve_runtime holds state/ledger while checking exact local admin and configuration_edit, sets runtime_owned by CAS, captures monotonic even epoch. prepare_start rechecks identity revision and validates saved configuration/policy; run opens configured native credential/listener before activate. activate rechecks original local authorization, revokes old browser leases/devices, and exact-CAS activates its original epoch. An intervening negative stop prevents late native-ready activation.

checkedContracts.contract: Old worker-only Enable cannot bypass ordinary native start
checkedContracts.detail: application dispatch intercepts ordinary Enable to start_teacher_https. web_editor::run rejects Enable unless Readiness.synthetic, whose positive fixture variant is cfg(test). set_enabled remains public for explicit diagnostics, so this is ordinary composition proof, not a claim that every library caller must supply native readiness.

checkedContracts.contract: Old Web lease does not revive across false/true epoch ABA
checkedContracts.detail: Backend session_guard checks atomic negative admission before acquiring ledger and again after actor verification. New activate cannot open a positive epoch without owning ledger and revoking old exact Web sessions; a guard blocked before restart therefore observes either negative admission or revoked lease, while one holding ledger cannot overlap a new activation. Material send fence captures exact runtime_epoch and checks it before/after. Existing tests include old lease after restart plus actual queued/precommit Writer negative stop, but this review did not run them.

schedule_shutdown returns while !teacher_https_quiescent; recovery coordinator requires teacher_https_quiescent before taking pool/writer owners. State.quiescent also requires preparation ticket gone, so suppressed preparation result is not treated as physical worker return.

limitations: No Cargo invocation, Windows operation, listener, network, or source edit.
C files remain under development and are not frozen; snapshots prove only the observed source bytes.
A pending native IOCP/WSACleanup sticky fault repair is not validated here.
New runtime and regression tests remain uncompiled/unexecuted until root integration checks.
